display.$description: Our display font; selected cases only, never running text. Files: assets/fonts/trackit-systems/ (ADR-0009)

text.$description: Text typeface for screens: websites, UI, data. Files: assets/fonts/alegreya-sans/ (ADR-0011)

serif.$description: Text typeface for print: running text in datasheets, flyers, documents. Files: assets/fonts/alegreya/ (ADR-0011)

display-bold.$description: trackIT Systems Bold, as in 'trackIT' of the wordmark

display-regular.$description: trackIT Systems Regular, as in 'systems' of the wordmark

text-regular.$description: Alegreya Sans / Alegreya Regular: running text

text-medium.$description: Alegreya Sans / Alegreya Medium; Alegreya Sans has no semibold

text-bold.$description: Alegreya Sans / Alegreya Bold: headings, emphasis
